fusions.name: Kicked Hive
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground around you, dealing 11 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Sting on the Bound
fusions.desc: Bounds in and stings an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 8 piercing damage, rising to 1.5 times that at 6 tiles. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Long Forage
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Humming Stride
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
